name: devcycle
description: Opinionated pipeline from a feature, bug, or refactor description to a verified, publish-ready implementation: scoped interview, spec, wave-based plan, TDD subagent execution, branch review, on-device verification.

profile.title: Pipeline profile
profile.description: Cost/rigor preset. One of: lean, standard, thorough. Individual knobs override it when explicitly configured.

gitPolicy.title: Git policy
gitPolicy.description: What the finish stage may do with the branch. One of: local-commits-only, push-allowed, open-pr.

docTrackingPolicy.title: Doc-tracking policy
docTrackingPolicy.description: What devcycle attempts to commit of the specs, plans, lessons, promotion records and audit reports it writes (the repo's own .gitignore always wins, and a few artifacts sit outside the policy). One of: all-local (commit none of them), standard (commit lessons, promotion records and audit reports; keep specs + plans local), all-tracked (also commit specs + plans).

implementerModel.title: Implementer model
implementerModel.description: Model id, a comma-separated pool of ids ordered from simplest to most capable, or 'auto' (default) to let the coordinator derive per task. A pool routes by task complexity; no value ever dispatches above the orchestrator's own model tier.

taskReviewerModel.title: Task reviewer model
taskReviewerModel.description: Model id, a comma-separated pool of ids ordered from simplest to most capable, or 'auto' (default) to let the coordinator derive per task. A pool routes by task complexity; no value ever dispatches above the orchestrator's own model tier.

walkthroughModel.title: Walkthrough model
walkthroughModel.description: Model id, a comma-separated pool of ids ordered from simplest to most capable, or 'auto' (default) to let the coordinator derive per task. A pool routes by task complexity; no value ever dispatches above the orchestrator's own model tier.

branchReviewModel.title: Branch review model
branchReviewModel.description: Model id, a comma-separated pool of ids ordered from simplest to most capable, or 'auto' (default) to let the coordinator derive per task. A pool routes by task complexity; no value ever dispatches above the orchestrator's own model tier.

reviewDepth.title: Review depth
reviewDepth.description: Branch review engine. Unset → the profile's branch-review row (single at lean and standard, panel at thorough); set → this value, verbatim, and the profile never moves it. One of: single (the review's criteria lenses run as inline read-only reviewers plus a per-finding refutation pass), panel (multi-lens review panel workflow), auto (identical to unset).

crossModelReview.title: Cross-model review
crossModelReview.description: Add a cross-model lens to the review panel when available.

onDeviceGate.title: On-device gate
onDeviceGate.description: Whether the on-device checklist closes only via a human walkthrough. Unset → the profile's on-device row (auto-ok at lean, human-required at standard and thorough); set → this value, verbatim, and the profile never moves it. One of: human-required, auto-ok, auto (identical to unset).

learnStalenessSessions.title: Learn staleness — sessions
learnStalenessSessions.description: How many sessions may accrue since the last /devcycle:learn before the finish stage surfaces a (non-forcing) nudge to mine again. Whichever of this or learnStalenessDays crosses first triggers the nudge.

learnStalenessDays.title: Learn staleness — days
learnStalenessDays.description: How many days may pass since the last /devcycle:learn before the finish stage surfaces a (non-forcing) nudge to mine again. Whichever of this or learnStalenessSessions crosses first triggers the nudge.
